description:
Cast Touch of Vitae by paying {2}{G}, targeting Faeburrow Elder.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental by paying {U}, causing it to gain Faeburrow Elder's activated abilities until end of turn.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental using Faeburrow Elder's ability by tapping it, adding at least {G}{W}{U}.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental using Faeburrow Elder's ability granted to it by Touch of Vitae by paying {0}, untapping Quicksilver Elemental.
Repeat from step 2.
